 orders or proceedings
Sl.
 Date or directions and Court'S Or Judges'S Orders

No 
 Registrar's order with  Signatures  WPCRL No. 1795 of 2025  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Ms. Prabha Naithani, learned counsel for the Petitioners.
2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is filed by the Petitioners to quash the impugned FIR dated 18.02.2023 registered as Case Crime No.83 of 2023, under Sections 420, 468, 471 of IPC, at Police Station Ramnagar, District Nainital and further to direct the Respondents not to arrest the Petitioners in connection with the abovementioned F.I.R..
4. Learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that in the present matter final report has been submitted despite that the Petitioners are being harassed.
Issue notice to the Respondent no.3, returnable within two weeks.
Steps to be taken within one week.

7. Objections, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.
8.

In the interregnum, it is directed that the investigation shall proceed but the Petitioner shall not be arrested by the police in connection with the impugned FIR dated 18.02.2023 registered as Case Crime No.83 of 2023, under Sections 420, 468, 471 of IPC, at Police Station Ramnagar, District Nainital.
However, they will continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of their statements.
10. Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2025) stands disposed of.

(Ashish Naithani, J.) 31.12.2025 Akash WPCRL/1795/2025 on 31 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185247332/
